text.Kredi notunun hangi aralıkta olduğunu gö: See which range your credit score falls into, learn the steps to take to improve your approval chances and explore offers that match your score.
text.Öğren, Onay Şansını Artır: Check: Know Yours and Boost Your Approval Odds
text.Bankalar başvurunu değerlendirirken önce: When evaluating your application, banks look at your credit score first. See which range your score falls into and learn the steps to take to raise it.
text.Notunun bankalar gözündeki karşılığı: What your score means to banks
text.Notuna uygun kredi ve kart teklifleri: Loan and card offers that match your score
text.Kredi notun hangi seviyede?: What level is your credit score?
text.Finansal durumunu bankaların gözünden gö: See your financial situation through the eyes of banks
text.Puanının hangi risk grubunda olduğunu ve: Learn which risk group your score falls into and how banks interpret it.
text.Ödeme alışkanlığı, borç oranı ve yeni ba: See how payment habits, debt ratio and new applications affect your score.
text.Notunu yükseltmek için önceliklendirilmi: Get prioritized, actionable steps to raise your score.
text.Notuna göre onay ihtimali yüksek kredi v: Focus on loan and card offers with a high chance of approval for your score.
text.Kredi notun ne anlama geliyor?: What does your credit score mean?
text.Findeks kredi notu 1 ile 1900 arasında d: The Findeks credit score ranges from 1 to 1900. The higher your score, the lower the risk banks consider you to be.
text.Kredi ve kart başvuruları çoğunlukla olu: Loan and card applications are usually declined.
text.Başvurular sınırlı limit ve yüksek faizl: Applications may be considered with a limited credit limit and high interest.
text.Çoğu bankada başvurun değerlendirmeye al: Your application will be considered at most banks.
text.Bankaların büyük çoğunluğu için güçlü bi: A strong profile for the vast majority of banks.
text.En avantajlı faiz ve limit tekliflerine: You can access the most favorable interest rate and limit offers.
text.Kredi başvurun neden reddediliyor olabil: Why might your loan application be declined?
text.Kredi başvuruların sık sık reddediliyors: If your loan applications are frequently declined, the reason may not be bad luck but a low credit score. The Credit Report evaluates your financial history and the information you provide to show what your credit score means, your chances of approval and the steps you need to take to raise your score.
text.Kredi notun, bankaların seni nasıl değer: Your credit score is the most important indicator of how banks evaluate you. A low score can lead to your applications being declined or to higher interest rates. With the right moves, you can raise your score and access better offers.
text.Notun; ödemelerini zamanında yapıp yapma: Your score is calculated based on whether you make your payments on time, the ratio of your existing debts to your limits, how intensively you use credit products and the new applications you've made recently. Your payment habits have the biggest impact.
text.Kredi Karnesi sana ne kazandırır?: What does the Credit Report do for you?
text.Kredi Karnesi sadece notunu göstermekle: The Credit Report doesn't just show your score; it helps you understand your financial situation through the eyes of banks. That way, you can clearly see the steps to take to raise your score and apply to the right bank at the right time.
text.Kısa sürede birden fazla bankaya başvurm: Applying to multiple banks within a short period can lower your score. Compare offers first, then apply for the best one.
text.Kredi Notunu Yükseltmenin 5 Etkili Yolu: 5 Effective Ways to Raise Your Credit Score
text.Kart borcunu limitinin altında tut: Keep your card balance below your limit
text.Yeni kredi başvurularını azalt: Cut down on new loan applications
text.Bütçeni planla, düzenli ödeme alışkanlığ: Plan your budget and build a habit of regular payments
text.Kredi notu, geçmiş kredi ve kredi kartı: A credit score is a number calculated from your past loan and credit card payments that indicates how likely you are to repay your debt on time. The Findeks credit score ranges from 1 to 1900; the higher the score, the lower the risk is considered to be.
text.Kredi notumu nereden öğrenebilirim?: Where can I find out my credit score?
text.Güncel kredi notunu Kredi Kayıt Bürosu’n: You can find out your current credit score through Findeks, a service of the Kredi Kayıt Bürosu (KKB, the Credit Bureau of Turkey), at findeks.com or via banks' mobile apps.
text.Kendi notumu sorgulamak notumu düşürür m: Does checking my own score lower it?
text.Hayır. Kendi kredi notunu sorgulaman not: No. Checking your own credit score does not affect it. However, making many loan applications within a short period can hurt your score.
text.Kredi notum ne kadar sürede yükselir?: How long does it take for my credit score to rise?
text.Düzenli ödemeler ve azalan borç oranı bi: Regular payments and a lower debt ratio start to show up in your score within a few months. The effect of late payment records fades over time, so never missing a payment is the fastest way.
text.Kredi Karnesi talebimden sonra ne olur?: What happens after I request a Credit Report?
text.Talebin bize ulaştıktan sonra seninle il: Once we receive your request, we'll get in touch with you. We'll review your credit situation together and share the steps you can follow to raise your score, along with loan and card offers that match your score.
text.Notuna uygun teklifleri görmek ister mis: Want to see offers that match your score?
text.Kredi Karnesi talebini bırak, kredi duru: Submit your Credit Report request, and let's review your credit situation together and share offers that suit you.
text.Çoğu bankada başvurun değerlendirmeye al: Your application will be considered at most banks. With a few months of regular payments and only a few new applications, you can access better offers.
